description: This file contains Swift unit tests for the Swabble configuration loading and saving functionality. It tests round-trip serialization/deserialization and error handling when configuration files are missing.

methods.name: configRoundTrip
methods.description: Tests that a SwabbleConfig object can be saved to and loaded from a JSON file correctly, and that the loaded data matches the original.

methods.name: configMissingThrows
methods.description: Tests that loading a non-existent configuration file throws the expected ConfigError.missingConfig error.
